arxiv-1603-04289.title: The Galois coaction on ϕ 4 \phi^{4} periods
arxiv-1603-04289.creator: Erik Panzer, Oliver Schnetz
arxiv-1603-04289.description: Abstract . We report on calculations of Feynman periods of primitive log-divergent ϕ 4 \phi^{4} graphs up to eleven loops. The structure of ϕ 4 \phi^{4} periods is described by a series of conjectures. In particular, we discuss the possibility that ϕ 4 \phi^{4} periods are a comodule under the Galois coaction.

arxiv-2011-13221.title: Comparative Analysis of Oscillating Wave Energy Converter Performance in Southern Coast of the Caspian Sea
arxiv-2011-13221.creator: Erfan Amini, Rojin Asadi, Danial Golbaz, Mahdie Nasiri, Seyed Taghi Omid Naeeni, Fereidoun Amini
arxiv-2011-13221.description: Abstract The importance of renewable energy supplies, particularly ocean wave energy, has become undeniable globally in the last two decades. Iran is not an exception due to the long barrier with deep water in the north and south of the country.

arxiv-2103-02410.title: OAG-BERT: Towards A Unified Backbone Language Model For Academic Knowledge Services Conference: Proceedings of the 28th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining; August 14–18, 2022; Washington, DC, USA Proceedings of the 28th ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data
arxiv-2103-02410.creator: Xiao Liu, Da Yin, Jingnan Zheng, Xingjian Zhang, Peng Zhang, Hongxia Yang, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang
arxiv-2103-02410.description: Abstract . Academic knowledge services have substantially facilitated the development of the science enterprise by providing a plenitude of efficient research tools. However, many applications highly depend on ad-hoc models and expensive human labeling to understand scientific contents, hindering deployments into real products.

arxiv-2103-07736.title: On the Approximate Purification of Mixed Strategies in Games with Infinite Action Sets
arxiv-2103-07736.creator: Yuhki Hosoya
arxiv-2103-07736.description: Abstract We consider a game in which the action set of each player is uncountable, and show that, from weak assumptions on the common prior, any mixed strategy has an approximately equivalent pure strategy. The assumption of this result can be further weakened if we consider the purification of a Nash equilibrium.

arxiv-2108-09892.title: Dynamic Orthogonal Matching Pursuit for Sparse Data Reconstruction
arxiv-2108-09892.creator: Yun-Bin Zhao 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}, Member, IEEE, and Zhi-Quan Luo 1 {}^{\textbf{1}}, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2108-09892.description: Abstract The orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) is one of the mainstream algorithms for sparse data reconstruction or approximation. It acts as a driving force for the development of several other greedy methods for sparse data reconstruction, and it also plays a vital role in the development of compressed sensing theory for sparse signal and image reconstruction.

arxiv-2310-14446.title: A Viscosity Solution Theory of Stochastic Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equations in the Wasserstein Space
arxiv-2310-14446.creator: Hang Cheung, Jinniao Qiu, Alexandru Badescu
arxiv-2310-14446.description: Abstract This paper is devoted to a viscosity solution theory of the stochastic Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation in the Wasserstein spaces for the mean-field type control problem which allows for random coefficients and may thus be non-Markovian. The value function of the control problem is proven to be the unique viscosity solution.

arxiv-2402-06047.title: Intelligent Mode-switching Framework for Teleoperation
arxiv-2402-06047.creator: Burak Kizilkaya, Changyang She, Guodong Zhao, Muhammad Ali Imran
arxiv-2402-06047.description: Abstract Teleoperation can be very difficult due to limited perception, high communication latency, and limited degrees of freedom (DoFs) at the operator side. Autonomous teleoperation is proposed to overcome this difficulty by predicting user intentions and performing some parts of the task autonomously to decrease the demand on the operator and increase the task completion rate.

arxiv-2402-13636.title: A Unified Framework and Dataset for Assessing Societal Bias in Vision-Language Models
arxiv-2402-13636.creator: Ashutosh Sathe, Prachi Jain, Sunayana Sitaram
arxiv-2402-13636.description: Abstract † † footnotetext: † Equal Contribution † † footnotetext: ‡ Work done when the author was an intern at MSR Vision-language models (VLMs) have gained widespread adoption in both industry and academia. In this study, we propose a unified framework for systematically evaluating gender, race, and age biases in VLMs with respect to professions.

arxiv-2502-16414.title: TabGen-ICL : Residual-Aware In-Context Example Selection for Tabular Data Generation
arxiv-2502-16414.creator: Liancheng Fang, Aiwei Liu, Hengrui Zhang, Henry Peng Zou, Weizhi Zhang, Philip S. Yu
arxiv-2502-16414.description: Abstract Large Language models (LLMs) have achieved encouraging results in tabular data generation. However, existing approaches require fine-tuning, which is computationally expensive. This paper explores an alternative: prompting a fixed LLM with in-context examples. We observe that using randomly selected in-context examples hampers the LLM’s performance, resulting in sub-optimal generation quality.

arxiv-2505-11621.title: A Classical View on Benign Overfitting: The Role of Sample Size
arxiv-2505-11621.creator: Junhyung Park, Shiva Prasad Kasiviswanathan, Patrick Blöbaum
arxiv-2505-11621.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Junhyung Park, Shiva Prasad Kasiviswanathan, Patrick Blöbaum. Benign overfitting is a phenomenon in machine learning where a model perfectly fits (interpolates) the training data, including noisy examples, yet still generalizes well to unseen data. Understanding this phenomenon has attracted considerable attention in recent years. In this work, we introduce a conceptual shift, by focusing on almost benign overfitting, where models simultaneously achieve both arbitrarily small training and test errors.

arxiv-2508-13338.creator: Duván Cardona, Manuel Alejandro Martínez
arxiv-2508-13338.description: Abstract . This paper finishes the goal of the authors started in two previous manuscripts dedicated to revisiting the continuity properties of toroidal pseudo-differential operators with symbols in the Hörmander classes. Here we prove pointwise estimates in terms of the Fefferman-Stein sharp maximal function and of the Hardy-Littlewood maximal function.

arxiv-2509-10536.title: Contextuality, Holonomy and Discrete Fiber Bundles in Group-Valued Boltzmann Machines
arxiv-2509-10536.creator: Jean-Pierre Magnot
arxiv-2509-10536.description: Abstract . We propose a geometric extension of restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs) by allowing weights to take values in abstract groups such as GL n ​ ( ℝ ) \mathrm{GL}_{n}(\mathbb{R}) , SU ⁡ ( 2 ) \mathrm{SU}(2) , or even infinite-dimensional operator groups.

arxiv-2601-08710.creator: Franz Baader ORCID:0000-0002-4049-221X, Oliver Fernández Gil ORCID:0000-0002-9458-1701
arxiv-2601-08710.description: Abstract . The unification type of an equational theory is defined using a preorder on substitutions, called the instantiation preorder, whose scope is either restricted to the variables occurring in the unification problem, or unrestricted such that all variables are considered.

arxiv-2602-23426.title: Extracting a Toponium Signal at the LHC with Spin and Quantum Information Tools
arxiv-2602-23426.creator: Laura Antozzi, Esteban Chalbaud, Frédéric Déliot, Federica Fabbri, Miguel C.N. Fiolhais, Benjamin Fuks, António Onofre, Martin White, Pengxuan Zhu
arxiv-2602-23426.description: Abstract We investigate near-threshold top-antitop production at the LHC, focusing on the impact of toponium formation on spin correlations and quantum information properties of the final state. Considering the top-antitop system as a mixed two-qubit state, we reconstruct spin density matrices via quantum tomography and evaluate several observables including some inspired by quantum information.

pmc-10595617.title: Encouraging the planetary health diet via food taxes and subsidies: a model concept
pmc-10595617.creator: A Mészáros, Z Vokó
pmc-10595617.description: BackgroundSeveral studies simulated the effect of food taxes and subsidies on health and environmental outcomes, but they are diverse and rarely model both health and the environment. Incomplete models’ estimates can be misleading: outcomes can be detrimental in a topic that was not included in the model.

pmc-11406066.title: Outbreak preparedness and response strategies in ASEAN member states: a scoping review
pmc-11406066.creator: Fingani Annie Mphande-Nyasulu, Nan Jiun Yap, Chin Hai Teo, Li-Yen Chang, Sun Tee Tay
pmc-11406066.description: Highlights•Multi-sector/multi-ministry collaboration is crucial for combating outbreaks.•Regional and cross-border networking is essential for responding to outbreaks.•Enhanced surveillance and innovation are key to early detection and response.•Regional networks are vital for improving responses to future outbreaks.•One Health collaboration is effective for future outbreak preparedness.

pmc-11636562.title: Measurement of treatment burden in patients with multimorbidity in the Netherlands: translation and validation of the Multimorbidity Treatment Burden Questionnaire (NL-MTBQ)
pmc-11636562.creator: Loes W S Engels, Tiny van Merode, Monique Heijmans, Juliane Menting, Polly Duncan, Jany Rademakers
pmc-11636562.description: BackgroundMultimorbidity is a growing problem. The number and complexity of (non-)pharmaceutical treatments create a great burden for patients. Treatment burden refers to the perception of the weight of these treatments, and is associated with multimorbidity. Measurement of treatment burden is of great value for optimizing treatment and health-related outcomes.

pmc-12465901.title: Neuregulin 4 inhibits synovial macrophage pro-inflammatory polarization via ErbB4/Stat5b/NF-κB signaling to alleviate osteoarthritis progression
pmc-12465901.creator: Daoliang Jiang, Xiaoli Xu, Wenjing Yang, Mengjia Tang, Yuping Zhang, Lingfeng Shi, Jiongyu Hu
pmc-12465901.description: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a chronic inflammatory disease characterized by synovial inflammation and cartilage degradation. Synovial macrophages, as a key driver of OA progression, during all stages of OA and induced to produce inflammatory cytokines that aggravate the degradation of cartilage.

pmc-12552522.title: An HD-EEG Database to dissect Somatosensory Awareness from Task Relevance and Report
pmc-12552522.creator: Maria Del Vecchio, Alice Giorgi, Erica Bonomi, Enrico Salemi, Davide Albertini, Flavia Maria Zauli, Ezequiel Pablo Mikulan, Andrea Pigorini, Pietro Avanzini
pmc-12552522.description: The search for the neural correlates of somatosensory perception is a topic of ongoing debate in the neuroscience community. In this context, Somatosensory Awareness Negativity (SAN, or N140) has been proposed as the neural signature of stimulus awareness, whereas the P3b component is more likely associated with post-perceptual processes such as report production or task relevance.

pmc-12577329.title: Preoperative rehabilitation and in-hospital mortality in delayed hip fracture surgery: a nationwide cohort study with stratification by kidney function
pmc-12577329.creator: Akira Okada, Akira Honda, Satoko Yamaguchi, Reiko Inoue, Kayo Ikeda Kurakawa, Toshimasa Yamauchi, Hirotaka Chikuda, Takashi Kadowaki, Masaomi Nangaku
pmc-12577329.description: BackgroundEarly surgery within 24–48 h is recommended for hip fractures; however, the majority of older adults experience delays due to medical instability. Evidence is limited on interventions during this waiting period. In cardiovascular and acute care, rehabilitation initiated immediately after admission has been shown to improve outcomes.

pmc-12609800.title: Hand Size Measurements in Children Aged 1–15 Years to Help the Development of Pediatric Electromyography Sensors for Neuromuscular Monitoring
pmc-12609800.creator: Réka Nemes, Erzsébet Németh, Katalin A Szatmári, Adrienn Timkó, Péter Luterán, Sorin J Brull, Béla Fülesdi, Adrienn Pongrácz, Peter Marhofer, Markus Zadrazil, Philipp Opfermann
pmc-12609800.description: Background/Objectives: The aim of this observational study was to collect hand measurements and anthropometric data in children aged 1–15 years of age to help the design of a pediatric skin electrode for electromyography-based neuromuscular monitoring. Methods: Data collection was performed at the Pediatric Department of the University of Debrecen Medical Centre between 1 December 2019 and 31 January 2021.

pmc-12799536.title: Impact of breast reconstruction on quality of life among women after mastectomy
pmc-12799536.creator: Anthony M. Ban, Branka V. Ličanin
pmc-12799536.description: ObjectivesBreast reconstruction after mastectomy represents an important component of rehabilitation for women who have survived breast cancer, although it is not considered a mandatory part of treatment. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of breast reconstruction on various aspects of quality of life, including physical, emotional, and social well-being, and to assess its contribution to overall patient satisfaction.

pmc-12929263.title: Moderating effect of autistic traits on the relationship between peripheral visual processing and facial emotion recognition
pmc-12929263.creator: Yuki Harada, Nana Kamei, Chiharu Tsukiyama, Kento Shiozaki, Junji Ohyama, Makoto Wada
pmc-12929263.description: Distinct visual processing patterns are one of the underlying mechanisms of atypical facial emotion recognition in individuals with autism spectrum disorder. However, the role of peripheral visual processing, particularly the functional field of view (FFOV), remains unclear. Therefore, this study aimed to examine the relationships among autistic traits, FFOV size, and facial emotion recognition ability.

pmc-13002161.title: Prevalence and Associated Factors of Excessive Dietary Supplement Use Among Japanese Adults: Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13002161.creator: Minami Sugimoto, Keiko Asakura, Nana Shinozaki, Kentaro Murakami
pmc-13002161.description: BackgroundThe use of dietary supplements (DSs) can lead to an excessive intake of certain nutrients, posing potential health risks. However, studies are scarce on whether DS users adhere to recommended doses provided by the manufacturer and what factors are associated with overconsumption of DS.

pmc-13575623.title: The Mediating Effect of Physiological Health Fear Between Depressive Mood and Sleep Quality in Elderly Parkinson's Disease Patients
pmc-13575623.creator: Ling Wu, Lihua Lu, Xiaopei Zhang, Tian Xu, Xiaosu Gu, Chen Shen
pmc-13575623.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the relationship between depressive mood and sleep quality in elderly patients with Parkinson's disease (PD), and to analyze the mediating role of fear of progression (FoP).MethodsBetween June 2024 and April 2025, 234 elderly patients with PD attending the Affiliated Hospital of Nantong University were enrolled.

pmc-13688819.title: “Being seen, heard, witnessed and acknowledged”: a reflexive thematic analysis of peer support following termination for medical reasons among women in Great Britain
pmc-13688819.creator: Heather Robinson, Ellie Vowles, Paul Marshall, Fiona Lobban, Áine Aventin
pmc-13688819.description: BackgroundTermination for medical reasons (TFMR) is associated with profound distress, grief and emotional trauma, as well as stigma and isolation. While peer support has been reported to reduce isolation and validate emotions in broader contexts, the distinct ethical and emotional complexities surrounding TFMR mean these findings cannot be assumed to transfer directly. TFMR‑specific evidence is therefore needed.
